patches.title: Handle empty non-final input in external entity subparsers
patches.description: Handle XML_TOK_NONE while an external-entity subparser is initializing after an empty non-final input chunk, so later input is parsed without dereferencing an unset event pointer.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream commit bfc28346fa3efeb8ca56c17437d24a7344e5feab; the same no-fuzz patch applies to both pinned Debian security sources after their quilt series.

tests.runner: getpatched/platform:verification/regression.py (compiled C API probe against the installed libexpat)
tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed baseline crashes with SIGSEGV when an external-entity callback parses an empty non-final subparser chunk and resumes with a processing instruction; the installed xmlwf reports the matching baseline upstream version.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed patched package completes the same parse, invokes the processing-instruction handler once, and the installed xmlwf reports the matching patched upstream version.

patches.title: Preserve allocation accounting across parser resets
patches.description: Keep tracked heap allocations made before XML_ParserReset in the allocator's baseline so a reused parser can still accept ordinary subsequent documents.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream Expat pull request #1431, merge commit d8f31e647a4d1eda088e89354f4769b0dad303d3; checked without fuzz against Expat 2.9.0 source.

tests.runner: getpatched/platform:verification/regression.py (compiled C API probe against the installed libexpat)
tests.baselineExpectation: After parsing a valid 70 MiB attribute value and resetting the exact installed baseline parser, parsing a small document on that parser fails with XML_ERROR_NO_MEMORY; a fresh parser accepts the same document.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed patched package parses the same small document after reset and reports no parser error; a fresh parser accepts the same document as a control.
